introduction.description: I am a Computer Science graduate from the University of San Carlos, Talamban Campus, with a strong passion for software development and a deep commitment to continuous learning. I am eager to apply my skills and knowledge in a challenging role within the software development field, where I can contribute to a dynamic and innovative team. My goal is to grow both personally and professionally by embracing opportunities to learn new technologies and expand my expertise in this fast-evolving industry. My commitment and dedication will help me succeed in any role where I can meet objectives and exceed expectations.

tasks: Developed a robust inventory system for monitoring and managing devices
Optimized and maintained UI Path automations, reducing repetitive manual tasks and improving efficiency
Created and supported development environments for relational and non-relational databases, ensuring reliable test and production workflows
Customized and containerized MongoDB images with Docker to handle specialized business requirements
Designed and built an automation testing tool, cutting regression test execution time and improving QA efficiency and reliability
Built and maintained an app that tracks device software and hardware integrity
Engineered AI language model prompts to enhance chatbot accuracy and improve customer query resolution rates.
Created a reusable web application template for AI-driven chatbots, reducing development time for new projects
Built an ordering portal with full e-commerce features (cart, shipment processing, and container truck delivery visualization), streamlining logistics and improving order tracking efficiency.
